name: Sacred Diwali Poojan Kit
description: Everything for Lakshmi Puja in one Sacred box: roli, chandan, akshat, haldi and haldi gaanth, gulal, sindoor, abir, kamal gatta, dhaniya, kauri, laung, elaichi, supari, honey, diya and cotton wicks, gulab jal, Ganga jal, kalawa, khil, batasha, janeu, a red cloth, the pujan vidhi booklet, agarbatti, dhoop cones, itra, kapur, and Ganesh ji, Lakshmi ji and Kuber ji for the puja.
